name: dsh-mobile-server
description: DSH Rust relay server and shared tunnel protocol

scripts.test: npm run test:relay-core && npm run test:relay
scripts.build:relay: cargo build --release --manifest-path server/relay/rust/Cargo.toml && npm run build --prefix server/relay/rust/console
scripts.test:e2e: node server/relay/rust/scripts/e2e.cjs server/relay/rust/target/release/dsh-relay && node server/relay/rust/scripts/e2e-stream.cjs server/relay/rust/target/release/dsh-relay && node server/relay/rust/scripts/e2e-mirror.cjs server/relay/rust/target/release/dsh-relay
